title: Thruxton RS Final Edition (Urban Commuter)
description: The Triumph Thruxton RS Final Edition (Urban Commuter) is crafted for flickable urban agility and stoplight-to-stoplight punch, positioned in the Heritage Cafe Racer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
